# Chat Attachments and Generated Image Preview Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add multi-file chat attachments, Codex image inputs, and inline previews for images generated by remote Codex.

**Architecture:** Keep the existing React-to-IPC-to-`AgentSession` pipeline. Add a focused attachment service for validation, SFTP, artifact discovery, local cache resolution, and cleanup; extend `AgentSession` only for command construction and structured image-path extraction; render persisted attachment/image message types in `ChatPanel`.

**Tech Stack:** Electron 33, React 18, Node.js built-in test runner, ssh2/SFTP, Codex CLI `exec --json --image`.

## Global Constraints

- Support multiple image, document, and code files; maximum 20 MB per file.
- Store remote inputs under `~/.remote-agent-studio/attachments/<conversation-id>/<message-id>/`.
- Store generated outputs under `~/.remote-agent-studio/artifacts/<conversation-id>/<message-id>/`.
- Codex images use `--image`; Claude Code receives attachment paths in prompt context.
- Do not add folder upload, a dedicated image mode, direct Images API calls, masks, galleries, or version comparison.
- Preserve existing text-only conversation history.
- Git is unavailable in this workspace, so each task ends with a test checkpoint instead of a commit.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement pure utilities**

```js
const path = require('path');
const MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES = 20 * 1024 * 1024;
const IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = new Set(['.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.webp', '.gif']);

function classifyFile(name) {
  return IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.has(path.extname(name).toLowerCase()) ? 'image' : 'file';
}

function sanitizeFilename(name) {
  const base = path.basename(name).replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}._-]+/gu, '_');
  return base.replace(/^\.+/, '') || 'attachment';
}

function validateFiles(files) {
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!file.path || !file.name || !Number.isFinite(file.size)) throw new Error('附件信息不完整');
    if (file.size > MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES) throw new Error(`${file.name} 超过 20 MB`);
  }
  return files;
}
```

Implement `extractImagePaths` as a recursive walk over strings, arrays, and objects. Match absolute Linux/Windows paths ending in a supported image extension, normalize duplicates, and ignore URLs.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement attachment-aware commands**

Build a context suffix before shell-quoting the prompt:

```js
const fileContext = files.length
  ? `\n\nAttached files available on this machine:\n${files.map((f) => `- ${f.name}: ${f.remotePath}`).join('\n')}`
  : '';
const artifactContext = artifactDir
  ? `\n\nIf this task generates images, save final PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF files under ${artifactDir} and report each absolute path.`
  : '';
const imageFlags = images.map((f) => `--image ${shellQuote(f.remotePath)}`).join(' ');
```

Place `imageFlags` with Codex global flags before `resume --last`. Claude receives the same file context but no `--image` flags.
